name: Google APIs
blurb: gcloud and Google's APIs, on every googleapis.com host.
guide: What the login or service account may do is the limit: Google enforces its roles, whatever this grant says.
For a service of your own the tool calls (behind Identity-Aware Proxy, say), add its host. To sign JWTs as a service account, as a client of such a service does, name it under May sign as.
